responsibility: Implements the core storage and stack-management methods of the Rust frontend’s TypeCheckContext declared in rust-hir-type-check.h. This file provides the singleton context instance, insertion and lookup of builtin and resolved TyTy types by HIR id or parser/node id, registration of implicit types created during inference, maintenance of the current return-type/context stack for nested item checking, and TypeCheckContextItem logic that recovers the current function-definition type from the stored context for item, impl-item, or trait-item bodies.
